🔥 Properties & Changes性质与变化

Physical vs chemical properties物理性质与化学性质

One bottle label says "colourless liquid" and also "highly flammable" — one line tells you what the liquid is like, the other tells you what it can turn into.同一个瓶子的标签上写着「无色液体」，又写着「高度易燃」——一句告诉你它长什么样，另一句告诉你它能变成什么。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 20 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Physical vs chemical properties物理性质与化学性质
  1. Physical property: observe or measure, substance unchanged (colour, density, mp, bp, hardness).物理性质：观察或测量，物质不变（颜色、密度、熔点、沸点、硬度）。
  2. Chemical property: how it reacts to form a new substance (rusts, burns, reacts with acid, tarnishes).化学性质：能怎样反应生成新物质（生锈、燃烧、与酸反应、变暗）。
  3. Matter has mass and takes up space; energy (heat, light) is not matter.物质有质量、占空间；能量（热、光）不是物质。
Physical property 物理性质
🎨 colour 颜色
🌡️ melting point 熔点
⚖️ density 密度
vs
Chemical property 化学性质
🔥 flammable 易燃
🟤 rusts 会生锈
🧪 reacts with acid 与酸反应

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Physical vs chemical properties物理性质与化学性质
  • Properties of matter物质的性质
    • Physical property物理性质observe or measure — no new substance观察或测量——不生成新物质

🧗 The hard part难点 · Physical vs chemical properties物理性质与化学性质

A property is an ability, not an event性质是能力，不是正在发生的事

Students think a chemical property must be happening in front of them.学生以为化学性质必须正在眼前发生。

  1. Ask: would testing this make a new substance?问：检测这个性质会生成新物质吗？
  2. Yes → chemical property, even if the sample is just sitting there.会 → 化学性质，哪怕样品现在只是放着。
  3. No → physical property.不会 → 物理性质。
Try试一试
"Sodium reacts violently with water." P or C?「钠遇水剧烈反应。」物理还是化学？
Answer答案
Chemical property.化学性质。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Physical vs chemical properties物理性质与化学性质
  • "Gasoline is flammable" → physical (nothing is burning) ✗ → chemical (ability to burn) ✓「汽油易燃」→ 物理（又没在烧）✗ → 化学（能燃烧的能力）✓
🎯
Underline the verb in the statement — it usually gives the answer away.圈出句子里的动词——答案通常就藏在里面。

🔥 Properties & Changes性质与变化

Extensive vs intensive properties广延性质与强度性质

A gold ring and a gold bar have very different masses, yet both have exactly the same density — so which properties care about "how much" and which do not?金戒指和金条的质量差很多，密度却完全一样——哪些性质跟「有多少」有关，哪些无关？

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 20 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Extensive vs intensive properties广延性质与强度性质
  1. Extensive = depends on amount (mass, volume, length, surface area).广延＝与量有关（质量、体积、长度、表面积）。
  2. Intensive = amount does not matter (density, mp, bp, colour, temperature, viscosity).强度＝与量无关（密度、熔点、沸点、颜色、温度、黏度）。
  3. Test: cut it in half — value halves → E; stays the same → I.判断：切一半——数值减半 → 广延；不变 → 强度。
D=Vm​
Extensive 广延性质
📦 changes with amount 随量而变
mass 质量
volume 体积
length 长度
vs
Intensive 强度性质
🔒 same for any amount 与量无关
density 密度
melting point, boiling point 熔点、沸点

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Extensive vs intensive properties广延性质与强度性质

      • mass质量

🧗 The hard part难点 · Extensive vs intensive properties广延性质与强度性质

Why density is intensive为什么密度是强度性质

A bigger object is heavier, so students think density grows too.物体越大越重，学生就以为密度也变大。

  1. Double the sample: m→2m, V→2V.样品加倍：m→2m，V→2V。
  2. D=2V2m​=Vm​ — unchanged.D=2V2m​=Vm​——不变。
Try试一试
Water: 10 g in 10 mL, and 250 g in 250 mL. Densities?水：10 g 占 10 mL，250 g 占 250 mL。密度各是多少？
Answer答案
Both 1.0 g/mL.都是 1.0 g/mL。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Extensive vs intensive properties广延性质与强度性质
  • Temperature → extensive ✗ → intensive ✓ (a cup and a tub can both be 40 °C)温度 → 广延 ✗ → 强度 ✓（一杯和一缸都可以是 40 °C）
🎯
Density = extensive ÷ extensive, so it is intensive.密度＝广延÷广延，所以是强度性质。

🔥 Properties & Changes性质与变化

Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化

Melting chocolate and burning toast both happen in a kitchen with heat — but only one of them gives you something you can never turn back into the original.巧克力熔化和吐司烤焦都在厨房里、都靠加热——但只有一个变出了再也变不回原样的东西。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化
  1. Chemical change: new substance forms; hard to get the original back.化学变化：生成新物质；难以复原。
  2. Physical change: same substance; only form, phase or appearance changes.物理变化：同种物质；只改变形状、相或外观。
  3. All phase changes are physical. Bubbles, heat or colour are clues, not proof.所有相变都是物理变化。气泡、放热、变色只是线索，不是证据。
Physical change 物理变化
🧊 melting 熔化
💨 evaporating 汽化
✂️ cutting 切割
same substance 还是同一种物质
vs
Chemical change 化学变化
🔥 burning 燃烧
🍳 frying an egg 煎蛋
🟤 rusting 生锈
new substance 生成新物质

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化
  • Changes in matter物质的变化
    • Physical change物理变化no new substance; form or phase changes没有新物质；形状或相改变
      • melting, freezing, boiling, condensing熔化、凝固、沸腾、液化
      • cutting, crushing, dissolving切割、压碎、溶解
    • Chemical change化学变化new substance; hard to get the original back生成新物质；难以复原
      • burning, rusting, tarnishing燃烧、生锈、变暗
      • cooking an egg, leaves changing colour煎蛋、树叶变色
      • clues: gas, precipitate, heat/light, new colour线索：气体、沉淀、放热发光、变色

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化

Deciding physical or chemical判断物理变化还是化学变化

🧗 The hard part难点 · Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化

Clues vs proof线索与证据

Students treat any bubbles, heat or colour change as automatic proof of a chemical change.学生把任何气泡、放热、变色都当成化学变化的铁证。

  1. Spot the clue (gas, heat, colour, solid).找到线索（气体、热、颜色、固体）。
  2. Ask: is it a new substance, or the same substance in a new phase?问：是新物质，还是同种物质换了相？
  3. New → chemical; same → physical.新的 → 化学；相同 → 物理。
Try试一试
A kettle gives off a cloud of steam. Chemical?水壶冒出一团蒸气。是化学变化吗？
Answer答案
No — water turning to vapour and back to droplets is physical.不是——水变成蒸气又凝成小水滴，是物理变化。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Physical vs chemical change物理变化与化学变化
  • Boiling makes gas → chemical ✗ → water vapour is still water → physical ✓沸腾产生气体 → 化学 ✗ → 水蒸气仍是水 → 物理 ✓
  • Broken glass cannot be undone → chemical ✗ → still glass → physical ✓碎玻璃复原不了 → 化学 ✗ → 仍是玻璃 → 物理 ✓
🎯
Ask "what is it made of afterwards?" — if the answer is the same name, it is physical.问「之后它是什么？」——名字没变就是物理变化。

cards.f: What is matter?什么是物质？
cards.b: Anything with mass that takes up space. Energy is not matter.有质量、占空间的一切东西。能量不是物质。

cards.f: Physical property — definition?物理性质的定义？
cards.b: Can be observed or measured without changing the substance.不改变物质本身就能观察或测量到的性质。

cards.f: Chemical property — definition?化学性质的定义？
cards.b: How a substance can react to form a new substance.物质能怎样反应、生成新物质。

cards.f: "Mercury is a liquid at room temperature" — P or C?「汞在室温下是液体」——物理还是化学？
cards.b: Physical (state at room temperature).物理性质（室温下的状态）。

cards.f: Signal words for a chemical property?化学性质的信号词？
cards.b: rusts, burns, flammable, reacts with, tarnishes.生锈、燃烧、易燃、与……反应、变暗（失去光泽）。

cards.f: Extensive property?广延性质？
cards.b: Depends on amount: mass, volume, length.与物质的量有关：质量、体积、长度。

cards.f: Intensive property?强度性质？
cards.b: Does not depend on amount: density, mp, bp, colour.与物质的量无关：密度、熔点、沸点、颜色。

cards.f: Fastest test?最快的判断方法？
cards.b: Cut the sample in half. Value halves → extensive; same → intensive.把样品切一半。数值减半 → 广延；不变 → 强度。

cards.f: Temperature — E or I?温度——广延还是强度？
cards.b: Intensive.强度性质。

cards.f: Extensive and intensive are types of which property?广延和强度是哪一类性质的分类？
cards.b: Physical properties.物理性质。

cards.f: Chemical change?化学变化？
cards.b: New substance forms; hard to get the original back.生成新物质；难以复原。

cards.f: Physical change?物理变化？
cards.b: No new substance; only form, phase or appearance changes.没有新物质；只改变形状、相或外观。

cards.f: Are phase changes physical or chemical?相变是物理变化还是化学变化？
cards.b: Physical — all six of them.物理变化——六种都是。

cards.f: Clues of a chemical change?化学变化的线索？
cards.b: New colour, gas, precipitate, heat or light — then confirm a new substance formed.变色、产生气体、沉淀、放热或发光——再确认有没有新物质。

cards.f: An egg is fried. P or C?煎鸡蛋。物理还是化学？
cards.b: Chemical — you cannot un-fry it; new substances formed.化学变化——煎熟的蛋变不回生蛋；生成了新物质。

quiz.q: Which is a physical property of copper?下面哪一项是铜的物理性质？
opts: It turns green when left outside for years.在户外放置多年会变绿。
It conducts heat well.导热性好。
It reacts with nitric acid.能与硝酸反应。
It forms a black coating when heated in air.在空气中加热会形成一层黑色物质。
quiz.hint: Only one option leaves copper as copper.只有一个选项里铜还是铜。
quiz.why: Correct: conducting heat can be measured without changing the copper.正确：导热性可以测量，铜本身不变。
whys: Turning green outdoors is copper reacting with air and water → chemical.在户外变绿是铜与空气和水反应 → 化学性质。
Correct: conducting heat can be measured without changing the copper.正确：导热性可以测量，铜本身不变。
Mistook "reacts with acid" for physical — any reaction forms a new substance.把「与酸反应」当成物理性质——凡反应都会生成新物质。
A new black coating is a new substance → chemical, not just a colour change.新生成的黑色涂层是新物质 → 化学性质，不只是颜色变化。

quiz.q: A note says: "Magnesium is silver-grey, has a density of 1.7 g/mL, and burns with a bright white flame." How many chemical properties are listed?一张笔记写着：「镁呈银灰色，密度为 1.7 g/mL，燃烧时发出耀眼的白光。」其中列出了几个化学性质？
quiz.hint: Split the sentence into three properties and test each one.把句子拆成三个性质，逐个判断。
quiz.why: Correct: only "burns" forms new substances; colour and density are physical.正确：只有「燃烧」生成新物质；颜色和密度是物理性质。
whys: Missed that "burns" is a chemical property even inside a description.没意识到描述中的「燃烧」就是化学性质。
Correct: only "burns" forms new substances; colour and density are physical.正确：只有「燃烧」生成新物质；颜色和密度是物理性质。
Counted density as chemical because it has a number — numbers are measurements, so physical.因为密度带数字就当成化学性质——数字是测量值，属于物理性质。
Counted colour as chemical — colour is seen by looking, so physical.把颜色也当成化学性质——颜色用眼看就知道，是物理性质。

quiz.q: Which pair are BOTH extensive?哪一组两项都是广延性质？
opts: mass and density质量和密度
volume and surface area体积和表面积
colour and length颜色和长度
temperature and volume温度和体积
quiz.hint: Both members must change when the sample is halved.两项都必须在样品减半时变化。
quiz.why: Correct: both get bigger with more substance.正确：两者都随物质增多而增大。
whys: Thinks density grows with size — it does not.以为密度随大小变化——其实不会。
Correct: both get bigger with more substance.正确：两者都随物质增多而增大。
Thinks colour depends on amount — a big or small piece has the same colour.以为颜色与量有关——大块小块颜色一样。
Thinks a larger amount of water is "hotter" — temperature is intensive.以为水多就「更热」——温度是强度性质。

quiz.q: Beaker A has 100 mL of water at 60 °C; beaker B has 400 mL of water at 60 °C. Which statement is true?烧杯 A 有 100 mL 60 °C 的水；烧杯 B 有 400 mL 60 °C 的水。哪句话正确？
opts: B has the higher temperature because it has more water.B 的温度更高，因为水更多。
B has 4 times the density of A.B 的密度是 A 的 4 倍。
A and B have the same temperature and density, but B has 4 times the mass.A 和 B 温度、密度相同，但 B 的质量是 A 的 4 倍。
A and B have the same mass because they are both water.A 和 B 质量相同，因为都是水。
quiz.hint: Sort each quantity first: temperature I, density I, mass E.先给每个量分类：温度 I、密度 I、质量 E。
quiz.why: Correct: temperature and density are intensive; mass is extensive and scales with volume (400 ÷ 100 = 4).正确：温度和密度是强度性质；质量是广延性质，随体积变化（400÷100＝4）。
whys: Treats temperature as extensive.把温度当成广延性质。
Treats density as extensive.把密度当成广延性质。
Correct: temperature and density are intensive; mass is extensive and scales with volume (400 ÷ 100 = 4).正确：温度和密度是强度性质；质量是广延性质，随体积变化（400÷100＝4）。
Confuses "same substance" with "same amount" — mass depends on amount.把「同种物质」和「同样多」混为一谈——质量取决于量。

quiz.q: Which is a physical change?哪一个是物理变化？
opts: A nail rusts outside.钉子在户外生锈。
Bread is toasted until brown.面包烤到焦黄。
Butter melts in a hot pan.黄油在热锅里熔化。
A cake bakes in the oven.蛋糕在烤箱里烤熟。
quiz.hint: Look for the phase change.找出相变。
quiz.why: Correct: solid butter → liquid butter, a phase change.正确：固态黄油 → 液态黄油，是相变。
whys: Rusting makes a new substance (rust) → chemical.生锈生成新物质（铁锈）→ 化学变化。
Browning toast is cooking: new substances → chemical. Colour change here is a real reaction.烤焦是烹饪：生成新物质 → 化学变化。这里的变色是真的反应。
Correct: solid butter → liquid butter, a phase change.正确：固态黄油 → 液态黄油，是相变。
Baking turns batter into new substances → chemical; heat alone does not mean physical.烘烤把面糊变成新物质 → 化学变化；用了加热不代表就是物理变化。

quiz.q: Water is heated and bubbles rise to the top. A student says, "Gas is produced, so this is a chemical change." Best reply?水被加热，气泡往上冒。某学生说：「产生了气体，所以是化学变化。」最好的回答是？
opts: Agree — any gas means a chemical change.同意——只要有气体就是化学变化。
Disagree — the gas is water vapour, the same substance in a new phase, so it is physical.不同意——气体是水蒸气，同种物质换了相，所以是物理变化。
Agree — you cannot easily get the water back.同意——水很难再变回来。
Disagree — it would only be chemical if the water reached 200 °C.不同意——只有水达到 200 °C 才算化学变化。
quiz.hint: Identify the gas before classifying.先确定气体是什么，再分类。
quiz.why: Correct: HX2​O(l)​HX2​O(g), no new substance.正确：HX2​O(l)​HX2​O(g)，没有新物质。
whys: Treats a clue (gas) as proof without asking what the gas is.把线索（气体）当证据，没问气体是什么。
Correct: HX2​O(l)​HX2​O(g), no new substance.正确：HX2​O(l)​HX2​O(g)，没有新物质。
Wrong reversibility: cooling the vapour easily gives water back.对可逆性判断错误：把水蒸气冷却就能轻易得到水。
Thinks temperature decides the type of change; it is the new substance that decides.以为温度决定变化类型；其实看的是有没有新物质。
